title: Deeper/broader cross-implementation 3D capability and loss-accounting audit
scope: Read-only primary-source comparison of explicit DXF geometry, ACIS/SAT/SAB, DWG conversion, and downstream projection boundaries; update plan readiness without claiming peer execution or format qualification.

sources.name: Autodesk POLYLINE DXF reference
sources.evidence: Documents distinct 2D/3D/poly-mesh/polyface flags and OCS-vs-WCS elevation semantics.
sources.limit: DXF entity contract only; not DWG layout, application behavior, or geometry-kernel evidence.

sources.name: Autodesk Polyface Meshes DXF reference
sources.evidence: Declared vertex/face counts need not be correct; writers should emit vertices before faces; readers should tolerate unusual child ordering.
sources.limit: DXF reader/writer structure only; does not validate manifoldness or rendered geometry.

sources.name: ezdxf ACIS API 1.4.5 documentation
sources.evidence: Reads SAT/SAB and exports supported ACIS structures; export errors for unsupported structures; flat-face mesh extraction loses curved faces; mesh-derived vertex bounds are approximate for curved geometry.
sources.limit: Project documentation; not independent B-rep correctness or native DWG/AcDs qualification.

sources.name: IxMilia/dxf repository support contract
sources.evidence: Declares DXF R10-R2014 support with named entity omissions and warns that some typed modeler entities may not open in AutoCAD when written.
sources.limit: Mutable repository self-description; no peer binary was built or executed.

sources.name: LibreDWG repository contract
sources.evidence: Repository documents read and write limitations that differ by version and direction; dxf2dwg is documented as R2000-only.
sources.limit: Mutable upstream documentation; exact comparator use still requires revision/tool/profile pinning.

sources.name: ACadSharp issue 1195 and linked PR 1240
sources.evidence: Open issue reports silent DXF writer omission of DWG-read 3DSOLID/REGION including block-only geometry; issue reports ACadSharp 3.4.9 and must remain revision-scoped.
sources.limit: Peer report, not reproduced on current release/master and not evidence of a libdxfrw defect.

sources.name: GDAL DWG driver documentation
sources.evidence: DWG driver uses ODA Teigha and exposes data through an OGR entity layer.
sources.limit: Not independent of ODA-based comparisons and not a whole-document CAD graph oracle.

sources.name: GDAL DXF driver documentation
sources.evidence: DXF is interpreted through OGR feature projection; curves may be tessellated and INSERT geometry is inlined/merged by default. INLINE_BLOCKS=FALSE exposes block/reference fields; AC1027+ 3D_EXTENSIBLE_MODE exposes raw ASM and transform, not OGR modeler geometry.
sources.limit: Projection-specific only; not full CAD identity/owner-graph, ACIS semantic, or native-consumer proof.

findings: No screened open-source route establishes the conjunction of DWG/DXF read-write, exact versioned entity semantics, arbitrary ACIS topology, curved B-rep geometry, and native consumer behavior.

Existing PAR-37/7V ASCII/Binary vectors cover stale counts, interleaved/forward face ordering, signed indices, and canonical output, but have no following-entity sentinel after SEQEND or focused fast selector/CTest.
Existing S2.3.9.4.29 and PAR-07/S8 per-body owner/INSERT/output/readback checks remain the right owners for silent block-content loss and explicit disposition.
Evidence must remain separated for explicit facets, SubD control cages, raw SAT/SAB, AcDs joins, interpreted B-rep, and consumer-imported geometry.
implementationReadyChecks: For PAR-37/7V, add a distinct LINE sentinel after SEQEND and assert its XYZ on input and strict write/readback; expose the existing ASCII/Binary case matrix through one focused selector/CTest.
Preserve canonical vertex-before-face output and validate active signed index magnitudes against actual coordinate records rather than declared header counts.
For ACIS, retain exact carrier and unsupported-node/error inventory; never use faceting or approximate curved-body bounds as a B-rep semantic oracle.
Pin peer revision, tool, operation, version, entity, and dependency lineage; distinguish project support declarations and issue reports from executed peer evidence.
Continue the next local slice if an external peer, platform, or independent semantic reader is unavailable; leave the external evidence cell NOT_RUN or DEFERRED_EXTERNAL.
